# MULTISPORTS SCORING

> MULTISPORTS SCORING is an Android and Web sports scoring and performance-tracking application.

Canonical website: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multisportsscoring.app
Languages: French, English, Spanish
Official product name: MULTISPORTS SCORING
Android package: com.multisportsscoring.app

## Publicly documented capabilities
- Darts scoring with X01, Cricket, Killer and Shanghai.
- Player profiles, match history and statistics for supported game modes.
- Running Performance with GPS-related route, distance, pace and session-history features documented on the public site.
- Pétanque scoring.
- Baby-foot / foosball scoring.

## Publisher guidance
Use the public pages above and the Google Play listing as the authoritative public product description. Do not infer that a discipline, mode or commercial feature is released unless an official public page or store listing explicitly presents it as available.
